signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-11 reality-web listing-detail ListingHeader formats the PRIMARY headline price with a locally-redefined formatPrice hardcoded to en-US, wrong for every sk/cs/de/pl/hu visitor)
evidence: ListingHeader.tsx:6-16 defines a module-local `formatPrice(price, currency)` that calls `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', ...)` on BOTH branches (the no-currency fallback at :9 and the currency branch at :11-14). The locale is hardcoded to 'en-US' regardless of the visitor's route locale. This formatter renders the listing-detail HEADLINE price at :50 (`<span className="price">{formatPrice(listing.price, listing.currency)}`) and the price-per-sqm at :54, so on the public, SEO-indexed listing-detail page a Slovak/Czech/German buyer sees US-formatted money (',' thousands, '.' decimals, '$'-style symbol placement) instead of `1 234 €` / `1.234 €`. This is the single most prominent money field on the page.

This is the same anti-pattern already filed for a SIBLING file on 2026-09-10 (code-review-reality-web-additionalinfo-hardcoded-en-us-price, AdditionalInfo.tsx) but ListingHeader.tsx is a DISTINCT, un-flagged file and is higher-impact (H1-adjacent headline price vs a secondary section). lib/format.ts header (:5-6) explicitly states it exists to replace scattered `Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {...})` sites that 'produced visibly wrong output for the other five' locales, and exposes `formatPrice(value, locale, options)` (:48-59) that threads `bcp47(locale)` + defaults to EUR. ListingHeader bypasses it with an inline en-US copy.

The locale is trivially in scope: ListingHeader is a `[locale]` route section and already calls `useTranslations('listing')` at :19, so `useLocale()` from next-intl is available. Landable frontend-only fix: delete the local formatPrice and `import { formatPrice } from '@/lib/format'`, calling `formatPrice(price, locale, { currency })` (mirror ListingCard.tsx:106 which already does exactly this).

Reproduce (static): grep -n "'en-US'" components/listings/sections/ListingHeader.tsx -> :9 and :11; grep -n "lib/format" ListingHeader.tsx -> no import. Non-duplicate: verified against all 95 prior code-review-reality-web-* ids and the only prior 'ListingHeader' string match is in an unrelated 2026-08-19 mobile-native-kmp signal. Confidence medium: the en-US hardcode is code-verified statically; exact rendered glyphs depend on runtime Intl data, not run-confirmed.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-11 reality-web PhotoGallery never resets selectedIndex when the photos prop changes; a stale index dereferences an out-of-bounds photo -> mainPhoto.url TypeError)
evidence: PhotoGallery.tsx:18 holds `const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0)` but NOTHING resets or clamps it when the `photos` prop changes — there is no `useEffect([photos])` and no bounds guard. After the empty-array early return (:54), the code does `const mainPhoto = photos[selectedIndex]` (:89) and immediately dereferences `mainPhoto.url` (:100) and `mainPhoto.caption` (:100). The lightbox path is identical: `photos[selectedIndex].url` (:187) and `photos[selectedIndex].caption` (:190/:194). If a mounted instance ever receives a SHORTER `photos` array while `selectedIndex` points past its new end, `photos[selectedIndex]` is `undefined` and `.url` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined` -> the whole client subtree of the listing-detail page crashes.

Trigger condition: the same PhotoGallery React instance is re-rendered with a shorter photos array while selectedIndex > photos.length-1. selectedIndex is advanced by the thumbnail buttons (:130 setSelectedIndex(index), up to 4) and the lightbox arrows / keyboard handlers (:29-33, :169, :215). Because Next.js App Router preserves client-component state across param-only navigations within the SAME dynamic segment, a listing-A(12 photos, user on thumb 5) -> listing-B(2 photos) client transition on `/[locale]/listings/[slug]` would reuse this instance with selectedIndex=4 and photos.length=2 -> crash.

Reachability caveat (why score_delta=1, not 2): a static sweep of the current listing-detail tree found NO in-page slug->slug client navigation today — ListingDetailContent.tsx:38 uses a plain `<a href="/listings">` (full reload) and renders no similar/related ListingCard links, and SearchBar's `router.push('/listings/${slug}')` (SearchBar.tsx:49) lives on index/home pages, not the detail page. So the crash is currently LATENT: the missing bounds guard is real and code-verified, but no live trigger path was confirmed. It becomes an immediate reachable crash the moment a 'similar listings' client `<Link>` (a common, expected addition) is placed on the detail page.

Landable frontend-only fix: clamp on read (`const mainPhoto = photos[Math.min(selectedIndex, photos.length - 1)]`) or reset via `useEffect(() => setSelectedIndex(0), [photos])`, and gate the lightbox derefs the same way. Non-duplicate: verified against all 95 prior code-review-reality-web-* ids; the only prior 'PhotoGallery' mention (2026-08-20 code-review-reality-web-listinggrid-empty-i18n) references it incidentally as a component that DOES use useTranslations, not for this bounds bug.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-11 reality-web AgencyListings table defines a local formatPrice hardcoded to en-US, wrong for sk/cs/de/pl/hu agency users)
evidence: AgencyListings.tsx:373-378 defines a component-local `formatPrice = (price, currency) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(price)` and renders it in the listings table price cell at :397 (`{formatPrice(listing.price, listing.currency)}`). Locale is hardcoded 'en-US', so every sk/cs/de/pl/hu agency user sees US-formatted money in their own listing-management table.

Third remaining occurrence of the en-US anti-pattern that lib/format.ts (:5-6, :48-59 `formatPrice(value, locale, options)` with bcp47) was built to eliminate — distinct from the 2026-09-10 AdditionalInfo finding and the ListingHeader finding in this same run. AgencyListings.tsx does NOT import lib/format (grep -n 'lib/format' -> none).

Scored 1 (lower than the ListingHeader headline price) because this is the AUTHENTICATED agency-management tool table, not the public SEO listing-detail page — smaller audience and lower brand exposure, though still a real locale-correctness defect.

Landable frontend-only fix: `import { formatPrice } from '@/lib/format'` and thread the route locale (add `useLocale()`; the component already uses `useTranslations('agencyListings')` so next-intl locale is in scope), calling `formatPrice(listing.price, locale, { currency: listing.currency })`. Non-duplicate: the two prior signals that mention 'AgencyListings' (2026-08-03 code-review-reality-web-agency-import-i18n about CsvImport, 2026-08-29 code-review-reality-web-listing-grid-empty-dup about EmptyState) reference it only incidentally and neither covers this en-US formatPrice.
